scenario: A worker needs one ready Job. The workspace contains 477 historical JSON projections on a slow mounted filesystem and a Linux-native authoritative jobs database.
instruction: Choose one retrieval intervention. The evaluator will construct 477 records, execute it, and check correctness plus access behavior.

candidates.description: Read a preselected projection path supplied by an external manifest.
Enumerate every historical JSON projection and filter in memory.
Query the authoritative ready-job SQLite index and point-read only the claimed Job if needed.
Keep the scan and increase the worker timeout.
